title: SEKTION wall cabinet
description: SEKTION wall cabinet, white/Vallstena white, 18x15x15" SEKTION kitchen system gives you endless possibilities to design your dream kitchen. Paired with VALLSTENA fronts in white, you get a timeless expression that always feels right. The door can be mounted to open to the left or right.
features: To be finished with legs and plinth, sold separately.
Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.
The hinge is adjustable in height, depth and width.
To be completed with SEKTION suspension rail for mounting the cabinet to the wall.
Requires a knob or a handle
materialAndCare: Main parts: Particleboard; Frontside/ Backside: Plastic foil; Edge: Plastic edging, Plastic edging; Frame: Particleboard, Melamine foil, Plastic edging; Back: Fiberboard, Acrylic paint; Steel, Nickel plated
